national_news.title: External Affairs Minister Highlights India-China Ties and Global South Concerns
bullets: External Affairs Minister Dr S Jaishankar noted that India-China relations have improved following the resolution of the border standoff.
Addressed trade agreement negotiations with the US, highlighting the distinct nature of India's small producers and agricultural sector.
Raised concerns regarding the devastating impact of ongoing geopolitical conflicts on Global South economies, energy tightness, and potential food crises.

national_news.title: Neeru Dhanda Wins Historic Gold at Asian Games 2026
bullets: Neeru Dhanda became the first Indian shooter to win a gold medal in the women's trap individual event at the Asian Games 2026.
Secured a silver medal in the women's trap team event alongside Aashima Ahlawat and Manisha Keer with a combined score of 328 points.
India registered strong medal performances across shooting, boxing, and athletics, moving up to the 11th place in the standings with 47 total medals.

national_news.title: Government Launches Pashudhan Bima Portal for Livestock Insurance
bullets: The Union Government launched the Pashudhan Bima Portal in New Delhi under the Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying.
Provides a single integrated digital platform for livestock insurance policy issuance, claim processing, real-time monitoring, and reporting.
Available in 11 regional languages alongside Hindi and English to enhance accessibility and transparency for livestock farmers.

national_news.title: Thane Hosts National Anti-Drug Dialogue Highlighting Vision Document 2026–2029
bullets: The Ministry of Home Affairs, Narcotics Control Bureau (NCB), and Press Information Bureau (PIB) hosted a national media dialogue in Thane.
Rolled out India's national 'Vision Document 2026–2029' to strengthen the Nasha Mukt Bharat mission against synthetic narcotics and darknet networks.
Emphasized a 'Detect, Disrupt, and Destroy' enforcement strategy combined with extensive public awareness to reach 50 crore citizens.

national_news.title: Union Minister Manohar Lal launches PRAGATI-50 initiative for urban cleanliness
bullets: Union Minister for Housing and Urban Affairs Manohar Lal launched the PRAGATI-50 initiative to develop 50 model cities across 24 states for swachhata.
The initiative operates under the framework of Swachh Bharat Mission–Urban 2.0, utilizing targeted, KPI-based action and tech-enabled monitoring.
It focuses on urban cleanliness, solid waste management, used water management, sanitation, and citizen participation within major economic and cultural centres.

national_news.title: Union Health Minister JP Nadda reviews healthcare infrastructure projects at Lady Hardinge Medical College
bullets: Union Health Minister JP Nadda reviewed infrastructure augmentation projects at Lady Hardinge Medical College (LHMC), Sucheta Kriplani Hospital, and Kalawati Saran Children’s Hospital (KSCH).
The KSCH expansion project aims to increase bed capacity from 394 to 894 beds, ICU capacity from 40 to 200 beds, and Operation Theatres from 4 to 12.
The review also highlighted the state-of-the-art Skill Lab for simulation-based medical training and the newly functional Augmented Level III-B Neonatal Care Centre.

national_news.title: India Marks 10th Anniversary of 2016 Surgical Strikes
bullets: India marked the 10th anniversary of the 2016 surgical strikes carried out by the Indian Army across the Line of Control (LoC) in PoJK.
The strikes were launched on September 28-29, 2016, as a direct military response to the Uri terror attack that claimed the lives of 19 Indian soldiers.
The government highlighted a decade of evolving security measures, citing subsequent actions like the 2019 Balakot airstrike and adherence to a zero-tolerance policy against terrorism.

national_news.title: Nation Pays Tribute to Shaheed Bhagat Singh on 119th Birth Anniversary
bullets: The nation observed the 119th birth anniversary of legendary freedom fighter Shaheed-e-Azam Bhagat Singh.
Born on this day in 1907 in Banga village (now in Pakistan), he sacrificed his life alongside Rajguru and Sukhdev for India's independence.
State-level events, including 'Jashn-e-Inquilab', were organized at Punjab Agricultural University in Ludhiana to honor his legacy.

national_news.title: Centre to Send Inter-Ministerial Teams to Karnataka and Maharashtra to Assess Drought
bullets: The Central Government announced the dispatch of teams to Karnataka and Maharashtra to assess the drought situation following declarations by the respective state governments.
Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan announced that a Central team will visit Karnataka on October 3rd.
The Union Minister also announced the nationwide 'Khet Bachao Abhiyan' campaign to promote balanced fertilizer application based on Soil Health Card recommendations.

bihar_news.title: Bihar DGP Vinay Kumar Appointed Chief Information Commissioner
bullets: 1991-batch IPS officer Vinay Kumar took VRS from the post of Bihar Director General of Police (DGP) and was appointed as the Chief Information Commissioner (CIC) of Bihar.
Preeta Verma, a 1991-batch IPS officer, was given the additional charge of Bihar DGP, becoming the first woman IPS officer to hold the post of acting DGP in the state.
The Chief Information Commissioner is an independent statutory body under the RTI Act, 2005, with members holding office for 3 years or until attaining 65 years of age.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM Directs Officials to Expedite Land Acquisition for Greenfield Airports
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister directed officials to accelerate land acquisition for greenfield airport projects at Ajgaibinath Dham and Sonepur under the Bihar Raiyoti Land Purchase Policy, 2026.
The first phase of the Ajgaibinath Dham Greenfield Airport will require investments of Rs 3,500 crore.
The Sonepur Greenfield International Airport's initial phase involves an investment of Rs 6,500 crore under the public-private partnership mode.

bihar_news.title: India Issues First PRAMAAN Certificates Under Forest Certification Scheme
bullets: India issued its first PRAMAAN certificates under the Indian Forest and Wood Certification Scheme (IFWCS) on 29 September 2026.
Certificates were handed over to the Andhra Pradesh Forest Development Corporation and a bamboo farmer from Odisha.
The scheme was launched in December 2023 by the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change to promote sustainable forest management and agroforestry.
